notes.title: DLC trains available. New free update: Wellbeing
notes.content:
Hello Urbekites,

After a lot of work the trains DLC is finally available

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696580/Urbek_City_Builder__Trains/

Also, a free update to the base game: welfare. It has new builds and the possibility to edit your saved maps, which is something the community had been asking me for a long time (thanks for your feedback!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/26440475e6d4e0428c43afc0b1a60fd1fcd76dd6.png[/img]

[h2]New buildings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fire station: with a fire truck
[*] Pharmacy
[*] Urban forest
[*] Mental Health Center
[*] Therapeutic community
[*] Psychiatric hospital
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/37ffc15e9830a544ada0dccb225846ea53aa5368.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/b13d33fd922ae72c80394f7e2f3211b3dc7e0f76.png[/img]

And as always, many thanks to the community for the ideas and support, which allow us to keep working on this game and adding more content.

If you want to be part of Urbek, enter to Urbek's discord:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/HyJSDDn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png[/img]
[/url]

notes.title: Soon new DLC: Defend the city
notes.content:
Hello Urbekites,
Soon you will be able to play a new DLC for Urbek: Defend the City with 2 new biomes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215480/Urbek_City_Builder__Defend_the_City/

[h3]War[/h3]
Build military facilities to be able to defend against enemy bombings. Increase the range of your defences so you can expand without fear of being destroyed by bombardment.

[b]Incremental bombardment[/b]: The attacks will get stronger and stronger and you will need better defences if you don't want to lose parts of your city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/eea3bc2cacbfed8f8db60133ebed2641101af6e3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/2376de4b6095903663f6f5a69c998638990db227.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/01d6626c3ea84cc7af5b81b81da6b1fd6d0ef748.png[/img]

[h3]Mountains[/h3]
Food is hard to come by in a frozen world. Give it a try! Although the snow will bring new tourism options, such as ski slopes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/6252d8fb5c79719fa67a8877448af5cfde9019fa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/ee0faef6a71af984067988e5dcab0dc30786c47c.png[/img]

In the discord I ask players different things to decide together about updates to the game, what new biomes to add, new features, ett, so join the discord
[url=https://discord.com/invite/HyJSDDn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png[/img][/url]
